scope: Runtime the recorded food-magnets trials ran on (versions read from each trial's run.json), plus the reference stack revisions shared with the accepted peg-out-a-tshirt task.

reference_stack.note: Same stack as peg-out-a-tshirt; these revisions were not re-read by run.py.

arena_asset_path_patch.reason: Use the public production asset root instead of unavailable staging assets (as peg-out-a-tshirt).

physics.bodies: rigid: four magnets (convex prisms), note card (0.2 mm plate), lid on a revolute hinge; sheet, stand and box body static colliders
physics.magnet_force: 6.27 N / (1 + gap / 1 mm)^2 toward the steel at each magnet's back-face disc, written before every physics step (12 per control step)

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA L40 48 GB (recorded trials); an RTX-class NVIDIA GPU with Vulkan rendering is required
